name: tck2trk
summary: This application converts tractography files from the .tck format to the .trk format. It uses a reference anatomy image in NIfTI format to ensure proper alignment.
description: Converts a .tck tractogram to TrackVis .trk with nibabel, taking the voxel-to-RAS affine, voxel sizes, dimensions and voxel order for the .trk header from a reference image. The reference is the first available of T1w, parcellation or mask (the T2w branch is unreachable because of a typo in main). Use it when a downstream tool needs .trk streamlines; the reference image must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: Optional T1-weighted image used as the reference for the .trk header (first choice).
Optional T2-weighted reference image; not selected by the current code because of a typo in main.
Optional mask used as the reference image if no T1w or parcellation is given.
Optional parcellation used as the reference image if no T1w is given.

outputs.description: The tractogram converted to TrackVis .trk format.

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid anatomical reference found in config.json
failure_modes.fix: Provide a T1w, parcellation or mask input as the reference image.
